header.bio: DJ & Sound System specialist. Three distinct musical formats for aperitivos, clubs, and festivals, paired with pro audio and lighting services for private and open-air events.

partySide.title: The Party Side
partySide.subtitle: Pop & Latin Hits House/EDM Remix
partySide.shortDesc: A more accessible, commercial House & EDM format, tailored to the crowd and the event. Recognizable vocals, current edits, and the right energy to keep everyone dancing. Focused on a clear electronic identity: zero reggaeton, trap, or generic radio trash.

grooveSide.title: The Groove Side
grooveSide.subtitle: Club House, Tech House & Techno
grooveSide.shortDesc: Pure House, Tech House, and proper Techno: from warm open-air melodies and curated aperitivos to hypnotic grooves and peak-time club drive. Zero trend-chasing, just quality electronic selection built around the room.

mainstageSide.title: The Mainstage Side
mainstageSide.subtitle: Festival Techno, Hardstyle & Bass House
mainstageSide.shortDesc: Built for big stages, large crowds, and maximum impact. Pure festival atmosphere where Techno, Hard Techno, and Hard Dance collide with iconic vocals and melodies to unite the entire dancefloor.

techSide.title: THE TECH SIDE
techSide.subtitle: Professional sound system rental and dedicated on-site audio engineering for events up to 250 guests.
techSide.philosophyTitle: Not just speaker rental, but live engineering on the field
techSide.philosophyQuote: The success of a night does not depend only on who is at the decks, but on everything happening behind the scenes so that sound and lighting hit exactly right. Acoustic tuning via iPad directly from the dancefloor, independent volume management for DJ and crowd, clean crossover cuts, and synchronized DMX lighting.
techSide.philosophyFeature1Desc: The engineer understands both the artistic requirements behind the decks and the crowd's emotional pulse on the floor.
techSide.philosophyFeature2Desc: Real-time FOH calibration directly in the center of the crowd for crystalline, balanced acoustic coverage everywhere.
techSide.philosophyFeature3Desc: Wired backup audio lines, surge-protected power, and dedicated booth monitors: unwavering reliability for the entire night.
techSide.packagesSubtitle: From full all-in-one setups with lighting shows to standalone Pioneer console rentals for specific rider requests.
techSide.equipmentSubtitle: Professional audio and lighting components selected and tuned for maximum performance.
techSide.gallerySubtitle: Authentic photography of our audio and lighting setups during club nights, private parties, and open-air festivals.
techSide.ctaBoxSubtitle: No complex forms. Tell me your party details (date, venue, expected guests, and technical preferences) and I'll respond swiftly.

partyhive.bioP2: From university collaborations to secret open-airs and club showcases, Partyhive stands out through technical precision, curated track selections, and an authentic community living electronic music to the fullest.
